info.title: Keel PLM programs API
info.description: Programs with their work breakdown, schedule, critical path, immutable schedule baselines, deliverables that point at Keel objects and gate reviews approved with signatures. Every response is limited to what the caller may read.

get.summary: Pools, roles, resources and assignments you may read. Rates only with the program cost permission.

put.summary: Sets the hourly rate of a role from a day on. Needs the program cost permission. Earlier rates stay.

get.summary: Allocated hours against capacity by resource and week, and the over-allocation periods (hours only).
Budget against actual against estimate to complete, by month and cost type, with the material estimate. Needs the program cost permission.

put.summary: Sets the budget of a cost type for the month of the given day. Needs the program cost permission. Changes are logged.

post.summary: Records an actual cost (labor from hours and a resource, other costs by amount, or a reversal). Recorded costs are never changed. Needs the program cost permission.

get.summary: Excel (all tables) or CSV (one table) of the resources, load and, with the cost permission, cost of a program. The banner is on the file.
